description: Validate and inspect a phone number with libphonenumber: whether it is valid (a real, allocated number) and/or possible (right length), its country, calling code, line type (mobile / landline / VoIP / toll-free / …) and every standard format (E.164, international, national) plus a wa.me link. Runs locally and offline. Does NOT check whether the number is registered on WhatsApp. There is no such API here.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g. "GB", "US") assumed when the number has no country code. Optional.

phone.description: The phone number to validate. International format with a leading "+" is best; otherwise also pass `country`.

name: validate_phone_number
